message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to real‑time data, so I can’t give you the current weather in London. If you’d like, I can explain how to check the weather using a weather API or a website, or I can give you a general idea of London’s typical climate for this time of year. Let me know how I can help!
message.reasoning: User asks: "what's the weather in london". We need to provide weather info. We don't have real-time data. We can respond that we can't fetch live data. But we can provide general info or ask for clarification. We can also mention that we can't access real-time weather. So respond politely.
